import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')];a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for c in cards[44:]:a.append(dict(card_id=c['card_id'],letters='y',marks='y',crop_ok='y',errors=[],detail='',owner_crop=dict(one_central_line='no',text_ne_visible_line='no',other_complete_line='no',gt2_whole_neighbour_words='no',turned_or_clipped='no'),where=[],segmentation_detail=''))
def ch(i,**kw):a[i-1].update(kw)
ch(24,letters='u',detail='Initial letters are fused by heavy ink; cannot securely distinguish tubus from tibus.')
ch(35,letters='u',segmentation_detail='The narrow diagonal strip shows only partial letter bodies, with no securely readable complete central word.');a[34]['owner_crop'].update(text_ne_visible_line='yes',turned_or_clipped='yes')
ch(45,letters='n',errors=['punctuation'],detail='βήσεται.. → βήσεται.',where=[{'label':'βήσεται.','printed':'βήσεται..'}])
for i in [46,47]:a[i-1]['marks']='na'
for i in [46,49]:
 ch(i,crop_ok='n',errors=['crop_clipped'],segmentation_detail='The line is turned approximately 90 degrees.');a[i-1]['owner_crop']['turned_or_clipped']='yes'
a[48].update(letters='n',errors=['crop_clipped','lookalike_script_letter'],detail='III → ΙΙΙ',where=[{'label':'ΙΙΙ','printed':'III'}])
ch(51,marks='n',errors=['wrong_mark'],detail='ἀπλαῖ → ἁπλαῖ')
ch(54,marks='n',crop_ok='n',errors=['missing_mark','crop_clipped'],detail='ῥίνην → ρίνην',segmentation_detail='The first and last characters touch the side boundaries and are clipped, especially final ὶ.');a[53]['owner_crop'].update(text_ne_visible_line='yes',turned_or_clipped='yes')
# Rotation is recorded in the owner field; the historical error vocabulary has no rotation code.
for i in [12,17,34,38,46,49]:
 a[i-1]['errors']=[x for x in a[i-1]['errors'] if x!='crop_clipped']
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(a)==len(cards)
assert [x['card_id'] for x in a]==[x['card_id'] for x in cards]
required={'card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'}
for x in a:
 assert required<=x.keys()
 assert x['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and x['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and x['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in x['owner_crop'].values())
print('Count and order verified:',len(a))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(x[k] for x in a)))
print('Errors',collections.Counter(e for x in a for e in x['errors']).most_common())
